messages:
alex: Kickoff for the enterprise POC — need a prompt inventory + baseline evals. Target: start next Mon, 4-week POC. Deliverables: 10-15 core prompts per flow, 50 golden examples per flow for evals, success criteria (accuracy / latency / reliability), and a pricing anchor. Added a draft doc: https://drive.redwood/ACME-poc/prompts. Who can own the prompt inventory?

mika: I can own prompt inventory. Quick q: are we doing multi-turn chat flows or single-turn generation for these use cases? Need an output schema for structured extractions.

alex: Primary is multi-turn chat for triage and recommendations, plus single-turn structured extraction for invoices. Main flows: invoice parsing -> field extraction, support triage -> intent + routing, policy recommendation -> scored suggestions. Jordan, please confirm priorities.

jordan: Confirmed. Priority 1: invoice parsing (extract invoice_number, vendor_name, total_amount, due_date), 2: triage intent classification (route to team A/B/C), 3: policy suggestion (give ranked policy snippets). We'll provide sample documents. For invoice parsing, sample prompt we use during POC: `Extract invoice_number, vendor_name, total_amount, due_date from the text` and return JSON.

sam: Infra note: customer requires data residency + audit logs. Are they expecting Dedicated or Private deployment? Also need an ask on committed throughput for pricing. @alex - any guidance?

alex: They requested Dedicated SLA during conversation. For pricing we should propose a reserved capacity commit (example: 5 concurrent streams / baseline throughput) + overage. Sales to define the $/mo anchor but include a 2-week proof trial.

jenna: Legal checklist: SOC2, encryption at rest/in transit, DPA + GDPR language, and PII redaction controls. I'll start filling the security questionnaire and vendor pack. Also need the prompt inventory to flag any PII-handling prompts.

mika: For the prompt baseline I will create a spreadsheet with columns: prompt_id, role (system/user), example_input, expected_output, eval_metric (F1/EM/Accuracy/Latency), pass_threshold. I'll seed ~12 prompts by EOD and link to the eval harness.

alex: Deliverables recap: prompt inventory link, initial eval harness (unit tests + 50 golden examples), infra spec (Dedicated config), and pricing sheet. Timeline: seed prompts Thu, evaluation harness Mon next week, POC start Mon following week. @sam can ops spin up a Dedicated trial for 2 weeks?

sam: Yes — can provision a demo Dedicated pool in us-west-2 for 2 weeks. Need signed NDA and a billing contact to enable provisioning. ops-bot: created a provisioning ticket.

ops-bot: Ticket created: P-4521. Assigned to eng-infra. ETA: 48-72h for initial provision.

jordan: We'll upload 25 sample invoices and 100 triage logs to the shared drive. Request: during eval please mask or redact account numbers / SSNs; we prefer token-level redaction during testing.

alex: Noted — include redaction step in eval harness and flag any prompts that leak PII. I'll update the doc and tag owners. Thanks all :thumbsup: Next check-in Fri EOD.
